# rethink some git aliases

Consider replacing three home-grown aliases with maintained tools:

```
- git state
  - https://github.com/akupila/gitprompt
- git release
  - https://github.com/caarlos0/svu
- git stats
  - https://github.com/caarlos0/org-stats
```

`gitprompt` renders branch/ahead/behind/dirty state for the prompt, which is what `git state` summarises by hand ([[DOT-92]]); `svu` computes the next semantic version from tags and conventional commits, overlapping `git release` ([git_current](../../bin/git_current)) and the never-built `git patch|minor|major` ([[DOT-10]]); `org-stats` aggregates contribution statistics across an organisation, overlapping [git_stats](../../bin/git_stats).
